diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says A, datasheet reading says S
diffs.evidence: Same pin, different label: DFRobot's SEN0121 product page gives the pin definition as 'Analog output (Blue wire) GND (Black wire) Power (Red wire)', and its 'Pin mapping comparison for the new analog sensor connector layout' drawing (image https://dfimg.dfrobot.com/enshop/image/data/SEN0127/pin mapping comparison_0x0.jpg.webp) labels pin 1 'S' on the blue wire, so the model's pin 1 'A' (analog output, blue) is that S signal pin; the original pin 1/pin 3 differences were real and were fixed by reordering the model to 1 A, 2 +, 3 - (new-version 1 S, 2 VCC, 3 GND), with check.ts PASS.
